NONE: › energy, or a willingness to be active

NONE: › a pill containing a drug that makes you feel more active

NONE: › a short speech intended to encourage people to work harder or try to win a game or competition

為了增加銷售量，老闆今天早上向職員們講了一番激勵的談話。

U: A2 [ U ] a grey or white powder produced by crushing dry peppercorns, used to give a spicy, hot taste to food

C: B1 also sweet pepper, US also bell pepper [ C ] a vegetable that is usually green, red, or yellow, has a rounded shape, and is hollow with seeds in the middle

salt and pepper
鹽和胡椒

紅椒很適合用烤箱烘烤來吃。
